messages:
michelle: Heads-up — coordinating HW marketplace pilot with Snowflake/Databricks + vector DBs (Qdrant) and our HW partners. Need to lock test matrix, cert owners, and announcement cadence. Meeting Thurs 11:00am PT? :calendar:
aj: Works for me. Put it on calendar.
samir: FYI I've pushed the connector smoke tests to CI branch `feature/marketplace-ci` — runs against Qdrant + local Snowflake sandbox. Logs at: https://ci.redwood/1234
michelle: Nice. Can you add Databricks cluster profile (m5.large -> r5.xlarge) to the matrix? We need to show perf numbers for both cloud and dedicated GPU paths.
evelyn: Marketing: we need an embargo window (48–72h) and a preferred GA week to coordinate announcements + webinar. any target weeks?
zach: For hardware partner, NVidia rep said they'd prefer a soft launch in week of April 18 and a full marketplace listing the week after. They need DGX-HX perf numbers and a short tech note.
nvidia-rep: Confirming — we'll provide DGX test runs next Tue. Will share logs and config: CUDA 12, driver 535, NCCL 2.18.
snow-eng: Snowflake marketplace checklist: security questionnaire, package manifest, logo assets, test artifacts. Recommend we start the security review this week.
databricks-partner: Databricks marketplace requires validated install script + sample notebooks. We can supply a template if needed.
michelle: Ok, updated agenda for Thu: 1) test matrix + owners 2) CI failing items 3) marketplace docs + marketing dates 4) webinar + press plan
samir: CI note — current flake: connector timeout when running qdrant load step under GPU-backed perf tests. Suspect kv cache mismatch. I'll dig in before Thu. Logs: `ci/connector_integration/987/log.txt`
evelyn: If we aim Apr 18 soft launch, embargo should be Apr 16 9am PT. We need a draft press blurb by Apr 10.
michelle: Action items:
- samir: fix qdrant timeout + attach verified run (due Wed EOD)
- zach / nvidia-rep: provide DGX perf logs + config (due Tue)
- snow-eng: start security questionnaire (owner: snow-eng) (due Wed)
- databricks-partner: provide install script template (due Wed)
- evelyn: press blurb draft (due Apr 10)
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing slot requested for Apr 22 — pending approval :information_source:
aj: I'll chase the CI failures and help repro locally today.
michelle: Thanks all. I'll send calendar invite and the draft agenda in #partnerships. If anyone can't make Thu 11am PT, ping me.
nvidia-rep: Thanks — we'll aim to have test artifacts up by Tue 5pm PT.
samir: One more: tagging infra to bump qdrant container memory to 8GB for perf runs — @zach can you approve?
zach: Approved. I'll request the infra change now.
michelle: Great — see you Thu. :rocket:
